title: shfl_xor butterfly source-lane derivation (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
32 lanes; graded over 5 separate launches, one per power-of-two mask (1, 2, 4, 8, 16).
This CUDA-C subset has no bitwise operators, so XOR-with-power-of-two must be derived arithmetically.
